title: Binance Says $6.34 Billion Hack Began With Fake Job Interview
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Says $6.34 Billion Hack Began With Fake Job Interview Binance’s incident report says the $6.34 billion Oct. 29 theft was a five-month campaign that began with a fake job interview and a poisoned developer tool. This post Binance Says $6.34 Billion Hack Began With Fake Job Interview first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
